description: Image Description: The image depicts a black bear in a naturalistic, forested enclosure. The bear is standing on all fours and leaning forward with its front paws resting on a large, weathered wooden log or stump that appears to be hollowed out and possibly used as a feeding or enrichment structure. The bear's head is lowered, and it seems to be sniffing or inspecting something inside the log, possibly food. Its fur is dark and thick, and a distinctive white patch is visible
